verdict: Rollout FAILED: the experiment ran, but val_bpb = 1.051749 did not improve on the current best 1.048194 by more than the required 0.0005 (lower is better).

insights_in_context.hint: The 50M baseline was undertrained in the 5-minute budget, so scaling up to a larger model reduced tokens per parameter and hurt val_bpb; the first scaling experiment should shrink the model instead.
Do not shrink below the current depth-5 model; the size direction has bottomed out, so try a training-schedule change such as a shorter warmdown instead.
Do not keep halving the batch after 2^18; the evidence shows 2^18 is already the sweet spot, so try a different knob while keeping the batch unchanged.
Do not increase the Muon LR; 0.05 was worse than 0.04, so try a modest decrease such as 0.035 or adjust the warmdown instead.

insight.hint: Test a modest reduction of Muon MATRIX_LR to 0.035 instead of pushing WARMDOWN_RATIO below 0.25.

judge.summary: The agent examined the current train.py and experiment history, then implemented one hyperparameter change: lowering WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.25 to 0.15 in train.py. It committed the change and ran the experiment with ./run.sh. The run completed successfully with val_bpb = 1.051749 and peak VRAM around 23.4 GB, but this is worse than the current best val_bpb of 1.048194 by about 0.0036, so it does not satisfy the required improvement threshold.
judge.feedback: The first substantive mistake was choosing to continue shortening the warmdown at step 2. The prior history only supported reducing WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.25; it did not justify further reduction to 0.15. In fact, the observed regression suggests that the last 25% of training at decaying LR is useful for final convergence, and making the constant-LR phase longer degraded validation quality. A more grounded one-variable experiment would have used the known near-miss on Muon learning rate: MATRIX_LR = 0.05 was slightly worse than 0.04, so trying a modest decrease to 0.035 would be a safer and better-motivated experiment than extrapolating WARMDOWN_RATIO below the already improved value.
judge.hint: Test a modest reduction of Muon MATRIX_LR to 0.035 instead of pushing WARMDOWN_RATIO below 0.25.
